test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the time taken by a 150 m long train, running at a speed of 63 km/h, to cross another train of length 100 m, running at a speed of 45 km/h in the same direction.
solution:
Given:

Length of train = 150m

Speed of train = 63 km/h

Speed of another train of length 100 m = 45 km/hr

Concept Used:

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/sec

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Total distance = 150 + 100

⇒ 250 m

Time = Total distance / Difference of speed

Time = 250/(18 × 5/18)

Time = 50 seconds

**The time one crosses another train is 50 seconds.**
